name: TraceShrink
desc: Cost-aware OpenTelemetry Collector processor. Keeps expensive traces, drops cheap ones — saving up to 98% storage costs. Includes a cost annotation processor that prices LLM spans using embedded pricing data for 2,764 models.

name: PromptFirewall
desc: Multi-layer prompt injection detection library. Rule-based scanning at 11.9μs per input — no ML model required. Ships as a Rust crate, Python package (PyO3), and npm package (napi-rs) with middleware for FastAPI and Express.

name: LogCompress
desc: Semantic log compression for incident investigation. Achieves 100% recall on benchmark (55/55 queries, 5 incident types) with trace-aware expansion that pulls all related log lines by trace ID. Parallel tokenization via Rayon.

name: CodeShrink
desc: Code-aware context compressor for LLMs. Extracts function signatures while discarding implementation details — 99.9% compression on large codebases (1.29M LOC → 1.5K in 2.8s). Helps fit entire repositories into LLM context windows.

name: MCP-Drill
desc: Fault injection and contract compliance testing for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. Verifies that AI tool servers handle edge cases, malformed inputs, and resource limits correctly. Generates compliance scorecards.
